pages.text: Stages one through five use finite item-only Kongqiao. Stage six unlocks aggregated Xianqiao items; fluids are Xianqiao-only. The storage key opens globally over most non-text screens and Escape returns to the prior screen.

The terminal supports smooth scrolling, localized name/tooltip/tag/namespace search, sorting, armor management and vanilla drag splitting. Items and fluids share one directory; fluid quantities display in buckets.

The built-in 3x3 grid automatically refills missing ingredients from personal storage. Match NBT controls exact Data Components matching only. Exact held-stack refill is managed from the Xianqiao management page.
